values.note: Overnight: Full Hookup $50, Premium Sites (50 amp) $58, plus state and county sales and tourist tax; 2 persons per unit, $3 per extra person, maximum 6. Stay 6 nights and get the 7th free. Daily reservations are paid in full as the deposit; cancel 14 days ahead. Rates page last modified July 2024.

note: RV campground at 1520 State Road 40, Astor, about 1/4 mile from the St. Johns River (bass fishing) and under a mile from the Astor boat ramp; rental cabins. Daily, weekly and monthly stays.
summary: Confirmed full hookups (now 50A), showers, laundry, phone booking, fees $50-58 (dated by the rates page's July 2024 Last-Modified); added 51 sites, dump station, fee details. Note trimmed of what the fields hold.
flags: Price at the line: the cheapest RV site is exactly $50.00/night before tax (Full Hookup), so not over the US$50 gate; with tax it exceeds it. No gateway within 40 km (nearest Orlando 71 km); the family has not stayed here.
The site's tel: link still dials the discontinued land line (386-749-3995); the entry's 352-636-3139 is the number the operator now gives.
